claim: One hour uses roughly 6–15 agent tool calls instead of about 130.
一小时大约只要 6 到 15 次工具调用，而不是大约 130 次。
`scripts/heartbeat_loop.py` appends one line per minute to `heartbeats.jsonl`.
`scripts/heartbeat_loop.py` 每分钟往 `heartbeats.jsonl` 追加一行。
At the deadline the script writes a `final` line and exits; the agent writes `summary.json` and reports what it measured.
到截止时间脚本会写一条 `final` 后退出，agent 再写出 `summary.json`，并报告实际测到的结果。
